'''Pecoppi parrots''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of barely-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Bird/Legends|birds]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Recopia]]. The parrots were often drugged and sold to pet collectors. These birds were an intelligent species, that were one of the few animals that could speak various languages. The birds were herbivores, eating [[Berry|berries]] and [[fruit]]s, but occasionally ate [[insect]]s. They could be found in various bright [[Color/Legends|colors]], and were often were affectionate to other parrots and other species, and were social and curious birds. They were not classified as sentient, although they passed the sentience test. They were illegal to hunt, however they were classified as threatened due to poaching and smuggling.<ref name="CatCW" />
